chapters.label: The save, live
chapters.text: Shanghai, the 2007 World Cup final. Germany lead Brazil one-nil, then Brazil win a penalty. Marta, the tournament's top scorer, steps up. Nadine Angerer waits on her line... Marta shoots. Angerer dives. Saved!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Angerer stays patient. She reads Marta's run, then dives. Strong hands!

chapters.label: Never beaten
chapters.text: From behind the goal: pushed away! Germany won two-nil, and Angerer let in no goals all tournament.

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Keepers, stay patient on your line. Read the kicker: her run and her hips. Then dive with strong hands.
